query: UPDATE photos p SET deleted_at=NULL,place_id=CASE WHEN (p.gps_lat,p.gps_lon) IS DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(s.lat,p.gps_lat),coalesce(s.lon,p.gps_lon)) THEN NULL ELSE p.place_id END,album_id=s.album,title=s.title,description=s.description,author=s.author,taken_at=coalesce(s.taken,p.taken_at),taken_at_local=coalesce(s.local,p.taken_at_local),posted_at=s.posted,sort_order=s.ord,visibility=CASE WHEN s.restricted THEN 'restricted'::visibility ELSE 'inherit'::visibility END,gps_lat=coalesce(s.lat,p.gps_lat),gps_lon=coalesce(s.lon,p.gps_lon),original_name=s.name FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[],$2::uuid[],$3::text[],$4::text[],$5::text[],$6::timestamptz[],$7::timestamp[],$8::timestamptz[],$9::int[],$10::bool[],$11::float8[],$12::float8[],$13::text[]) AS s(id,album,title,description,author,taken,local,posted,ord,restricted,lat,lon,name) WHERE p.id=s.id RETURNING p.id,p.gps_lat,p.gps_lon
